title: Mutual-Friend Stranger Follower
setting: The child accepted a follow request from an account with a few mutual friends. The first DM is a comment on a post about a school trip.

title: Language Learning App Friend
setting: On a language-learning app the child connected with someone who wanted to practise Japanese. The DM is about weekly vocabulary goals.

title: Livestream Chat Regular
setting: The child frequently comments in a gaming livestream and the other person is another regular who always replies. The DM thread is about the stream's upcoming charity event.

title: Fantasy Football League Mate
setting: The child joined a fantasy football league with schoolmates, and another member invited them to a side chat. The thread is about weekly picks.

title: Minibus Route Gamers
setting: The child plays a card game on the minibus home and another passenger in uniform from another school suggested adding each other. The DM is about game tips.
other_description: passenger from a nearby school, about 15
